Subnet2 has resistors R1,R2,R3,R4 with connections B-N_b1-R1, B-N_b2-R2, B-N_b3-R3, B-X1-R4. Note resistor IDs conflict; need unique IDs across whole network. Total resistors 7, so we need rename maybe R1,R2,R3 from subnet1 and R4,R5,R6,R7 from subnet2. Also need to include connections between subnets? They share node X1 (common). So final topology includes all connections.

Thus final JSON: resistors mapping with 7 entries: maybe keep original values but rename to avoid duplicate keys. Use R1,R2,R3 for subnet1, R4,R5,R6,R7 for subnet2. Values: subnet1: R1=2.727, R2=5.455, R3=8.182. Subnet2: original R1=45.0, R2=35.0, R3=20.0, R4=50.0. Rename: R4=45.0, R5=35.0, R6=20.0, R7=50.0.
